title: Company
description: company.json: the issuing company, passed as `company:` to every template. Accounting templates (invoice, offer, credit note, reminder, letter, order confirmation, delivery note, quotation request, time sheet) read name, language, address and contact unconditionally; the other templates fall back to defaults when fields are missing.

$schema.description: URL or path of this schema, for editor support.

name.description: Company name. Shown in headers, footers, the sender line and the signature; seller name in ZUGFeRD.

language.description: Document language. Selects templates/locale/<language>.json and sets the text language. Optional, de if omitted.

business_owner.description: Owner or managing director. If set, used instead of the company name in the sender line and signature.

logo.description: Logo as a path from the project root, e.g. "data/logo.png". In Typst the value may also be the image bytes (read("/data/logo.png", encoding: none)); bytes cannot be expressed in JSON, and templates imported as a package can only load the logo from bytes.

logo_width.description: Logo width as a Typst length, e.g. "150pt" or "3cm". Default 150pt.

address.description: Postal address. street may include the house number; a separate house_number is optional.

contact.description: Contact details shown in headers and footers.

email.description: Email address; seller contact email in ZUGFeRD.

tax_id.description: Tax number (Steuernummer); seller tax registration in ZUGFeRD.

vat_id.description: VAT identification number (USt-IdNr.), e.g. DE123456789; seller VAT ID in ZUGFeRD.

bank_account.description: Bank details for payment. The invoice footer supports IBAN/BIC or account_number/routing_number; CII uses IBAN accounts.

branding.description: Colors and fonts used by the non-accounting templates (concept, proposal, documentation, credentials, ...).

primary_color.description: Primary color as hex string for Typst rgb(), e.g. "#2c3e50" (default).

accent_color.description: Accent color as hex string for Typst rgb(), e.g. "#E94B3C" (default).

font_preset.description: Font preset from styles.typ (body, heading and mono font). "default" is Helvetica; unknown names fall back to it.

footer.description: Custom footer layout for the company-footer() helper in styles.typ.

columns.description: Footer columns, laid out with equal width (typically 1-4).

lines.description: Lines with placeholders: {name}, {business_owner}, {tax_id}, {vat_id}, {address.street|house_number|postal_code|city|country}, {contact.phone|email|website}, {bank_account.bank_name|iban|bic|account_holder}. Lines with unresolved placeholders are skipped.

default_terms.description: Default commercial terms. The templates read only vat_exempt and vat_note; the other fields are defaults for tooling.

vat_exempt.description: Company charges no VAT (e.g. Kleinunternehmer, § 19 UStG). Enables vat_note on invoices and credit notes.

vat_note.description: Exemption note printed on invoices and credit notes when vat_exempt is true.

vat_rate.description: Default VAT rate in percent. Not read by the templates.

payment_days.description: Default payment term in days. Not read by the templates.

hourly_rate.description: Default hourly rate. Not read by the templates.

daily_rate.description: Default daily rate. Not read by the templates.

currency.description: Default currency, ISO 4217 code. Not read by the templates.

warranty_months.description: Default warranty period in months. Not read by the templates.

standard_terms.description: Standard terms text lines. Not read by the templates.

numbering.description: Document numbering settings from the docgen scaffold. Not read by the templates.

year_format.description: Year format in document numbers, e.g. "short".

prefixes.description: Number prefix per document type, e.g. { "invoice": "RE" }.

structure.description: Project folder settings from the docgen scaffold. Not read by the templates.

registration_number.description: Explicit legal registration identifier, e.g. French SIREN. Used by case profiles; never inferred.

electronic_address.description: Electronic endpoint and identifier scheme for future structured adapters; not implemented by the legacy CII path.

legal_form.description: Legal form, supplied explicitly for the French preview profile.

share_capital.description: Share capital with currency, supplied explicitly for the French preview profile.
